text:
maria (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — demo day pre-show for the LangChain + Gateway partner on Wed 10:00am PT. Can we run a short checklist here?
jonathan (PM): Thanks. Can we confirm seating for the live demo and the fallback plan if our dedicated pool flaps?
lee (Eng): I can take ownership of capacity/fallback. Current plan: primary = dedicated pool in us-west2, fallback = hosted small instance (quantized). Need autoscale limit bump by +2 for the 15m window.
nashley (Marketing): I'll draft the joint blurb and coordinate social assets. Do we have approved co-branding from partner legal?
sam (Partner Eng): Partner legal approved the blurb yesterday, they attached a screenshot of the signed asset in the partner portal. I can DM the file.
maria (Partnerships): Perfect. Action items: @lee - autoscale bump and smoke test; @sam - verify SSO/SAML flow; @jonathan - run the demo script w/ the partner once today; @ashley - finalize assets and embargo timing.
lee (Eng): Smoke test window open 8:30–9:00 PT tomorrow. I'll run `curl` healthcheck and KV cache warmup. Example:```bash
curl -sSf https://us-west2.api.redwood.ai/v1/health || echo 'health fail'
# warm cache
curl -X POST https://us-west2.api.redwood.ai/v1/batch/warm -d '{"prompts": ["welcome"]}'
```
jonathan (PM): I'll run the script at 9:15 with partner — please standby in the greenroom channel.
ashley (Marketing): Embargo window proposed: publish @ 11:00am PT Thu. That gives us time for post-demo edits.
sam (Partner Eng): SSO checklist: metadata upload done, assertion consumer URL validated, partner cert rotates monthly — confirm our SP accepts new certs automatically. I tested a login flow with test user `partner_demo@acme.com`.
lee (Eng): Good catch on cert rotation. I'll add a small script to pull partner certs from the portal and reload the SP key at `/opt/redwood/sso/reload.sh` during the demo prep.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to demo cluster succeeded — image: redwood/demo:2026-03-20-rc3. All services healthy.
maria (Partnerships): Nice, thanks @deploy-bot. One more ask: can someone prepare a one-slide failover diagram I can share with partner PM? Minimal — show primary, fallback, and who to page.
ashley (Marketing): I'll make the slide and drop in the thread by EOD today.
jonathan (PM): If autoscale bump is risky we'll do a dry-run today with synthetic load. @lee can you schedule 5m synthetic token burst?
lee (Eng): Yep. I'll run the synthetic at 9:00 PT during smoke test. Will post logs here.
sam (Partner Eng): Also adding a small data-sanitization note for demo — we must mask any PII in partner prompts. I sent a cleaning script to the partner.
maria (Partnerships): Awesome. TL;DR: smoke test tomorrow 8:30–9:00, synthetic burst 9:00, partner script run 9:15, slide + assets by EOD. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
lee (Eng): Copy. Will post smoke test output: `ok 200 /health`, `cache warmed: 3 keys`.
jonathan (PM): Thanks all — see you in greenroom. :rocket:
